mainEntity.name: How does customer query research for GEO help with content strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: This research guides content strategy by revealing the specific questions and needs local customers have. Businesses can then create highly relevant blog posts, landing pages, and service descriptions that directly address these queries. For example, if many local searches are for 'best plumbers in Los Angeles', content can be tailored to highlight expertise in that specific region, attracting more qualified local leads.
acceptedAnswer.description: It helps content strategy by revealing local customer questions and needs, allowing businesses to create highly relevant, targeted content that addresses specific regional queries.
